test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the sentence parts:

(A) to submit (B) asked him (C) the report (D) the manager
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **DBAC**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject, "The manager," which is correctly indicated by **part (D).**
 
• Following the subject, "asked him" **(DB)** continues the logical flow, forming the action of the sentence.
 
• **The next part,** "to submit," **(DBA)** specifies what the person is being asked to do.
 
• **Ending with** "the report" **(DBAC) **completes the sentence by stating what the action is about.

Correct sentence: The manager asked him to submit the report.

Therefore, the correct answer is **DBAC.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 2 (BACD):** This option starts with "asked him to submit the manager," which is grammatically incorrect and changes the intended meaning.
 
• **Option 3 (DBCA):** This option starts with "The manager the report asked him to submit," which disrupts the logical flow of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4 (DCAB):** This option starts with "The manager to submit asked him the report," which creates a fragmented and confusing sentence structure.
